## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 37. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke records the sequence plainly: Anderson's second stint at Southern Miss was to serve as the OC and QB coach, but Charles Huff left for Memphis and the Golden Eagles opted to keep it in-house with Anderson. He weighs the résumé from both directions — a decade of FBS coaching experience, but also an unceremonious departure from Utah State and no coaching in 2024; Arkansas State taken to new heights from 2014-20 and an 11-win season at Utah State to start that tenure. His verdict is that this is a fairly uninspiring hire in Hattiesburg. He closes on the human side: Anderson has won at both stops and has done so while navigating some very difficult and tragic family circumstances, so we'll see how this stop goes.
